title: Column layout

attributes.name: disable-responsive
attributes.description: keep columns side-by-side on small screens; boolean flag: emit name=name (presence is truth)

attributes.name: item-padding
attributes.description: padding inside each column, px (0-120, step 4)

attributes.name: item-margin
attributes.description: margin around each column, px (0-120, step 4)

agent_notes: layout lists relative column widths (1-1 = two equal columns); every child must carry slot=col-N matching the layout's column count. Legacy numeric aliases (12, 8, 6/6, 4/4/4, 3/3/3/3) are accepted at runtime.
